name: seo-audit
title: SEO Audit
description: Crawl a site's whole sitemap and check every page for the SEO, metadata and structured-data problems single-URL graders miss. Nothing leaves this machine.
author: nurkamol

commands.name: preview
commands.title: Preview a Site
commands.subtitle: SEO Audit
commands.description: How big is this site, and is it the right one — three requests, about a second.

commands.name: audit
commands.title: Audit a Site
commands.subtitle: SEO Audit
commands.description: Crawl a site and list what to change, worst first.

commands.name: reports
commands.title: Recent Reports
commands.subtitle: SEO Audit
commands.description: Runs kept by the macOS app and by this extension.

preferences.name: limit
preferences.title: Pages per run
preferences.description: A launcher is a poor place to wait out a crawl of a thousand pages. Big sites belong in the app or the terminal.

preferences.name: speed
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.description: Gentle is one connection at a time — the setting that gets through a site answering HTTP 429.

preferences.name: checkExternal
preferences.title: Outbound links
preferences.label: Check that links to other sites still resolve
preferences.description: Slower, and only a 404, 410 or no answer is reported.
